dsmUrl.label: DSM URL
dsmUrl.help: Base URL of the Synology DSM web UI. Include the port if non-standard (default 5000 for HTTP, 5001 for HTTPS).

username.label: Username
username.help: DSM account with permission to manage snapshots. Use a dedicated service account.

shareName.label: Shared folder
shareName.help: Name of the shared folder to snapshot (without leading slash).

ignoreCert.label: Ignore certificate errors
ignoreCert.help: Required when the DSM uses a self-signed certificate.

form.appPasswordHint: Recommendation: create an app-specific password from DSM Control Panel → User & Team → User → App Passwords. This scopes credentials to backup operations only and can be revoked without changing the primary password.

setup.title: Before you start
setup.intro: snapshot-synology talks to the DSM 7.x Backup Service REST API. Confirm the DSM side is configured, then fill in the form.

steps.title: Enable the Backup Service API
steps.body: Control Panel → External Access → Certificate → Add. Open Control Panel → Backup Service and confirm the service is running. The REST API listens on the DSM HTTPS port (default 5001).

steps.title: Create an app-specific password
steps.body: Control Panel → User & Team → User → Account → App Passwords → Add. Label it 'McHarbor snapshots' and grant only the permissions needed (DSM and Backup Service). The generated password is what you paste into the form.

steps.title: Choose or create a shared folder
steps.body: Open Control Panel → Shared Folder. Either snapshot an existing folder (recommended: an empty folder reserved for McHarbor backups) or create a new one. Note the folder name exactly — it is case-sensitive on the DSM.

steps.title: Verify DSM reachability from the host
steps.body: From the host where McHarbor runs, confirm HTTPS connectivity. Replace nas.local with your DSM hostname:

steps.title: Test the connection
steps.body: After saving the configuration, click 'Test Connection' in the Snapshots tab. A green probe result confirms the DSM accepted the credentials and the shared folder is reachable.
